content_of_post_to_answer: How do I stop stressing about things I can't change?
answer: A lot of stress comes from treating acceptance as giving up. They are different. Acceptance means seeing reality clearly enough to stop wasting energy fighting what has already happened, while still choosing what you can influence next. A useful question is not “How do I stop caring?” but “Is this worry helping me respond or just making me suffer twice?” Your mind is trying to protect you, but not every problem needs to be solved; some only need to be released.
